findings.title: Error IDs mismatched to nodestore data via zip(values())
findings.body: In fetch_error_details the code builds node_ids from error_ids, calls nodestore.backend.get_multi(node_ids) which returns a dict keyed by node_id, then does zip(error_ids, events.values()). Dict values order is not guaranteed to match error_ids order, and missing keys shrink values. The result pairs the wrong title/message/timestamp with the wrong error id. Consequence is wrong error context merged into replay breadcrumb logs sent to Seer, producing misleading AI summaries.

findings.title: Flagged table visualization discards real query results
findings.body: When organization.features includes use-table-widget-visualization the code renders TableWidgetVisualization with hardcoded columns={[]} and tableData {data:[], meta:{fields:{}, units:{}}} instead of using result.data, result.meta, fields, and fieldAliases computed above. Consequence is dashboards behind the flag show empty tables regardless of query results.

findings.title: Merged-PR template calls truncate on wrong class
findings.body: The diff defines _truncate_title as a staticmethod on CommitContextIntegration but get_merged_pr_single_issue_template calls PRCommentWorkflow._truncate_title. PRCommentWorkflow is not the class defining the helper in this file. If PRCommentWorkflow does not provide that method this raises NameError/AttributeError at runtime. Consequence is suspect-issues PR comment generation for GitHub and GitLab crashes and no comment is posted.

findings.title: Age/timestamp exclusivity uses truthiness and neither is required
findings.body: validate_timestamp checks if self.initial_data.get("age") and validate_age checks get("timestamp"). Values of 0 are falsy, so a report with age=0 plus timestamp or timestamp=0 plus age incorrectly passes, and both age and timestamp are optional so a report with neither also passes. The Reporting specs require exactly one of age or timestamp. Consequence is invalid reports are accepted and mixed-spec reports with zero values are not rejected.

findings.title: Column fallback crashes when meta is missing
findings.body: The fallback does Object.keys(tableData?.meta.fields) and tableData?.meta.fields[key]. The optional chain only guards tableData, not meta. If tableData is undefined or has no meta, this throws TypeError. Consequence is dashboard or story rendering an empty or loading table crashes instead of rendering empty.

findings.title: Attribute-keys query key omits organization and changes caching
findings.body: The refactor replaces useApiQuery with path /organizations/<slug>/trace-items/attributes/ with useQuery keyed only as ['use-trace-item-attribute-keys', queryOptions] where queryOptions has no org slug. Switching organizations reuses the prior org cached TagCollection. It also drops staleTime 0, refetchOnWindowFocus false, and retry false. Consequence is stale cross-org attribute suggestions and extra retries and refetches.

findings.title: Analytics recorded before feature and validation checks
findings.body: analytics.record for preprod_artifact.api.assemble runs before the organizations:preprod-artifact-assemble feature check and before schema, missing-chunk, and state validation. Every POST including disabled-feature, malformed, and unauthorized calls is counted. Consequence is inflated assemble metrics and stored organization/project/user ids for requests that should not count.
